name: _meta
script: return "大相册滚动性能：420 张照片墙顶/中/90%/触底四点截图 + 视口图片加载断言（应用滚动容器是内层 main.overflow-y-auto，触底需循环滚动）。前置：GALLERY_DEMO_LARGE=420 node scripts/gen-demo.mjs。"

name: 01-home-large
script: const h = [...document.querySelectorAll('h3')].find(el => el.textContent.includes('大相册压力测试')); if (!h) throw new Error('大相册旅行缺失（需要 GALLERY_DEMO_LARGE=420 重新 gen-demo）'); 'found'

name: 02-open-large
script: const h = [...document.querySelectorAll('h3')].find(el => el.textContent.includes('大相册压力测试')); h.click(); 'ok'

name: 03-top-loaded
script: const imgs = [...document.querySelectorAll('main img')].filter(i => { const r = i.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.bottom > 0 && r.top < innerHeight }); const bad = imgs.filter(i => !(i.complete && i.naturalWidth > 0)); if (bad.length > 0) throw new Error('视口内未加载图片 ' + bad.length); 'top-ok'

name: 05-mid-loaded
script: const imgs = [...document.querySelectorAll('main img')].filter(i => { const r = i.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.bottom > 0 && r.top < innerHeight }); const bad = imgs.filter(i => !(i.complete && i.naturalWidth > 0)); if (bad.length > 0) throw new Error('中部视口未加载 ' + bad.length); 'mid-ok'

name: 07-deep-loaded
script: const imgs = [...document.querySelectorAll('main img')].filter(i => { const r = i.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.bottom > 0 && r.top < innerHeight }); const bad = imgs.filter(i => !(i.complete && i.naturalWidth > 0)); if (bad.length > 0) throw new Error('深部视口未加载 ' + bad.length); 'deep-ok'

name: 08-scroll-bottom
script: const sc = document.querySelector('main.overflow-y-auto'); for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) { sc.scrollTop = sc.scrollHeight; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 350)); } 'ok'

name: 09-bottom
script: const sc = document.querySelector('main.overflow-y-auto'); if (sc.scrollTop + sc.clientHeight < sc.scrollHeight - 50) throw new Error('未触底'); const imgs = [...document.querySelectorAll('main img')].filter(i => { const r = i.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.bottom > 0 && r.top < innerHeight }); const bad = imgs.filter(i => !(i.complete && i.naturalWidth > 0)); if (bad.length > 0) throw new Error('底部视口未加载 ' + bad.length); 'bottom-ok'
